description: The macOS Beebeeb window (`main`, task 1683 slice 1; spec docs/specs/2026-10-24-macos-two-surface-app.md §4, §7): Home and Settings in one window. macOS only, because no other platform builds it. The default capability's grants except `window-state:default` (a Mac does not run the window-state plugin; the window keeps its own frame): its toolbar and sidebar top are a `data-tauri-drag-region` (start-dragging), and it reads and listens like every other app window. Slice 2 adds `core:window:allow-set-title` (granted to this window alone): signed out the title follows the heading of the sign-in card shown (spec C C-W8), signed in it is "Beebeeb".
